data.name: Filippo
data.gender_notes: Filippo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Philippos in Greek, which is a combination of Philos (lover) and hippos (horse). The name Filippo is thus a tribute to a lover of horses. The name Filippo carries the meaning “Lover of horses” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Filippo usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of horses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and loyalty to one's beliefs and passions.
data.etymology: Filippo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of horses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Filippo total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: פיליפו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פיליפו הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו אוהב סוסים או חובב סוסים. השם פיליפוס נמצא בברית החדשה ומתייחס לאחד מתלמידי ישו וגם לאביו של אלכסנדר ורופוס. השם היה פופולרי בקרב הנוצרים הראשונים והוא עדיין בשימוש היום בקרב קהילות נוצריות שונות.

in_greek.name: Φίλιππο
in_greek.meaning: Φίλος ίππων (φίλος = φίλιππος) - φίλος του ίππου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φίλιππο προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'φίλος' που σημαίνει φίλος και 'ίππος' που σημαίνει άλογο. Ο Φίλιππος ήταν ένας από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού και αναφέρεται στα Ευαγγέλια του Ματθαίου, του Μάρκου, του Λουκά και του Ιωάννη. Το όνομα Φίλιππος ήταν κοινό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και μεταφέρθηκε σε πολλές γλώσσες μέσω της εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Philippus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Philippus is derived from the Greek words 'philos' meaning friend and 'hippos' meaning horse. Philippus was a common name in ancient Greece and was adopted by the Romans. In Christian tradition, Philippus is the name of one of Jesus' twelve apostles, mentioned in the New Testament. The name has been popularized throughout history by several saints and biblical figures.

in_english.name: Filippo
in_english.meaning: Lover of horses or horse lover
in_english.long_meaning: The name Filippo is of Greek origin, derived from 'philos' (love) and 'hippos' (horse). It was popularized by Saint Philip, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, mentioned in the New Testament. Filippo has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing a deep love and connection to horses, reflecting strength, loyalty, and courage. The name Filippo carries significant historical and spiritual weight, embodying the values of friendship and loyalty.

data.cultural_impact: In Italian culture, Filippo is a name that evokes a sense of strength, power, and tradition. Historically, Italian nobility, warriors, and renowned artists bore the name Filippo. Today, Filippo remains a popular name in Italy, often passed down through generations. The name carries an inherent Italian pride and a sense of connection to Italy's rich history.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, Filippo is believed to have been a disciple of Jesus Christ along with his brother Bartolomeo. As one of the twelve apostles, Filippo played an instrumental role in spreading the teachings of Christianity throughout Europe. The name Filippo is thus deeply spiritual, symbolizing faith, devotion, and a commitment to spreading the teachings of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Filippo, meaning "lover of horses" in Greek, symbolizes strength, courage, and dedication. Spiritually, it represents the journey of an individual who overcomes fear and embraces the challenges of life with unwavering faith and determination.

historical_references.reference: Born in the Italian city of Florence in 1415, Filippo was a renowned painter of the Early Renaissance period.
Filippo Lippi is best known for his religious paintings, including the Madonna and Child with Two Angels and the Annunciation.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Filippo remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named David Filippo in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Filippo, which means "Lover of horses". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
